title: Forge detention-cart shackles and a brass name-plate

approval.notes: Design contract for P4-006 playable cycle.

concrete_order: Forge detention-cart shackles and a brass name-plate before the Coastal Gate prisoner transfer.
hidden_contradiction: Every plate Kalev forges decides whether Mart is cleared at the guild hearing, redirected onto false evidence, or concealed through a hidden shackle release.

investigation_clues.summary: A seized rebel dispatch lists Mart as a Pikk Street harbor contact.
Kaja's wax-sealed dispatches hide between salt barrels.
Smuggled spearheads travel in empty barrel returns.
Henning's rope requisition ties the detention cart route to watch boats.

forging_options.label: Forge true name-plates and testify at the St. Olaf guild hearing.

effects.summary: Forged honest detention name-plates and testified at the St. Olaf guild hearing.

forging_options.label: Forge a false name-plate implicating a dead Novgorod clerk.

effects.summary: Forged a false name-plate implicating a dead Novgorod clerk in the harbor round-up.

forging_options.label: Forge a concealed shackle release and swap the brass name-plate.

effects.summary: Forged a concealed shackle release and swapped the detention name-plate to protect Mart.

night_consequence: The forged detention hardware changes coastal transfer routes, false-evidence risk, and Hingepuu reflection marks during the install beat.

source_notes.summary: Commission contract for The Price of a Name cycle.
